content.comment_body: Hello, I have one [product_name] basic module using six memory bits. I would like to send an SMS when any memory bit value changes. In the [product_name] communication module, the memory bit value appears as "OFF," but it shows "ON" on the main module. Another challenge is that transferring the [product_name] web editor program does not work directly. I have to deploy using an SD card, which is inconvenient since I need to physically move it to the PC. Additionally, I'm facing an issue with the analog value: it ranges from 0-10V, representing a current of up to 2A (0V = 0A, 10V = 2A). I want to display this value on the web interface with one decimal point (e.g., 1.1A). Could you please assist me? Apologies for my English.
Hello, Did you update the [product_name] communication module firmware to the newest version? You can find more information and the firmware update files at [url]. Hope this is helpful.
Hello, The firmware version on my [product_name] communication module is [version_no]. I'm downloading the new update now to test it. Thank you!

Hello, Regarding program transfer: with [product_name] [version_no], the transfer from [product_name] web editor to the controller module is encrypted. Since the controller isn't very powerful, even a simple project can take several minutes to transfer. It's just a note that moving the project to the SD card on a PC isn't required. About using both the [product_name] communication module and the web server simultaneously, I'm not sure. Hope this information helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience multiple usability problems when combining [product_name] communication modules with the main controller, including issues with real-time value monitoring, inconvenient deployment processes, and limited formatting of analog data on the web interface. There is uncertainty about how memory bit values synchronize between devices, and users are dissatisfied with slow or cumbersome program transfer procedures. Additionally, expectations for detailed analog value display are not being met.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want instant synchronization of memory bit values between the main controller and communication module, a simple and efficient program transfer process without handling SD cards manually, and clear analog value display with decimals on the web interface.
